name: smwmusic-lagrange-point-elevator-cutscene
title: Lagrange Point - Elevator Cutscene
description:
The sound effect played when you're transitioning into an elevator. A faster version is included, when it's played on an horizontal version of the elevator on the game.
There's an endless version included inside both text files, in case you want to use it forever. If you want to use the endless version, change the Endless_Elevator define to 1.
